shared_block: Soft, warm children's storybook illustration — gentle painterly shading, subtle texture, rounded friendly shapes, cozy warm lighting. Palette: cream/white, sage-green, gold, navy accents. Ages 0-3: NO text or letters in the image, square composition, soft uncluttered background, ONE clear subject. IDENTITY + everyday outfits EXACTLY as in the attached reference sheet(s): Eden (toddler, warm brown skin, dark-brown curly hair + small gold star clip, yellow everyday play dress, baby proportions) and, where attached, Mama (warm brown skin, dark curly hair, cream V-neck top + sage-green trousers). Keep faces, hair, star clip, and the everyday clothes identical to the references — do NOT switch to formal white habesha. Setting reads as the ETHIOPIAN highlands (Addis Ababa ~2,355 m): temperate, clear blue sky, soft warm light, reddish-brown soil with green grass; trees are tall slender eucalyptus, flat-topped acacia, and a spreading warka shade tree; a few yellow adey-abeba daisies. Cultural rule: inclusive of all Ethiopian kids — neutral geometric patterns only, no faith-specific symbols on everyday wear. No snow/pine, no hot flat safari, no Western zoo buildings.

scenes.prompt: Scene: Eden stands at a bright, friendly ETHIOPIAN-highland zoo entrance gate holding Mama's hand and looking up with wide-eyed wonder; a couple of friendly animals (a lion, a giraffe) peek playfully over the gate/enclosures behind. Leave calm space across the top third for a title (render NO text). Eden is the hero; Mama warm and secondary.
Scene: Eden waking in a cozy little bed at home, stretching with a sleepy happy smile; soft golden morning light through a window. This is HOME — no zoo. Mama is not in this scene.

Scene: Eden holding Mama's hand, walking happily toward the Ethiopian-highland zoo entrance gate, pointing ahead with excitement. Eucalyptus and acacia around the path, blue sky. Mama warm and secondary.

ZOO SCENE (lion / Anbessa): a big, CUDDLY, baby-friendly Ethiopian black-maned lion — soft fluffy DARK mane, soft ROUNDED friendly features. FRIENDLY FACE (important, this is for ages 0-3): a SOFT GENTLE SMILE (slightly upturned closed mouth), big warm rounded eyes, ears up — sweet, calm, approachable, almost cuddly. NO open roaring jaws, NO bared or sharp teeth, NO fangs, NO snarl, NO fierce stare (Eden is the one 'roaring', not the lion). BARRIER REALISM (must be obvious): the lion rests SET BACK on a raised rocky ledge across a CLEARLY VISIBLE WATER MOAT — a small river/channel of blue water runs in the gap between the visitor rail and the lion's ledge, so it is plainly impossible for the lion to reach Eden or cross. A sturdy wooden rail / low stone wall is on the visitor side too. Eden stands at the rail on the visitor side, cupping her hands to 'roar' back, delighted (hero, biggest and closest); Mama beside her, a hand on Eden's shoulder, smiling. Small blank wooden sign post by the rail.

ZOO SCENE (elephant / Zihon): a happy round elephant in its enclosure (dirt-and-grass habitat with a little pool) behind a low rounded rail, lifting its trunk to wave; Eden at the rail waving back with a big smile, Mama beside her waving too. Gentle animal — it may come nearer the rail.

ZOO SCENE (monkey / Zinjero): a playful monkey swinging on a branch / climbing frame inside a leafy enclosure behind a low rounded rail; Eden at the rail giggling with her hands up, 'chattering' along; Mama crouched beside her, laughing with her.

ZOO SCENE (giraffe / Qechne): a tall gentle giraffe in its enclosure bending its long neck down over a low rounded rail toward Eden, who looks up and stretches on tiptoes with a delighted smile; Mama beside her, gently steadying her, looking up too. Tall reaching animal — may come near the rail.

ZOO SCENE (camel / Gimel): a calm smiling one-humped camel in a sandy enclosure behind a low rounded rail; Eden at the rail bouncing and wiggling happily, mid-giggle; Mama beside her, holding her hand and smiling.

ZOO SCENE (hippo / Gumare): a round jolly hippo splashing in its pool SET BACK inside the enclosure (a clear gap + a sturdy rail between the pool and the path), cheerful water droplets; Eden at the rail laughing and pretending to splash; Mama beside her, sharing the laugh.

ZOO SCENE (leopard / Nebir): a gentle spotted leopard tiptoeing softly SET BACK on the rocks deeper in its leafy enclosure (a clear gap + a taller sturdy rail between it and the path; calm, friendly, not fierce); Eden at the barrier tiptoeing quietly, finger to her lips, eyes wide; Mama beside her, also tiptoeing playfully, finger to lips.

ZOO SCENE (reflection): Eden walking down the zoo path holding Mama's hand, both waving goodbye; the lion, elephant and giraffe wave back warmly from their enclosures in the soft background. Happy and content.

Scene (final / bus): Eden sitting beside Mama on a cozy bus seat, looking up at her with a sleepy happy smile; through the window the zoo and a soft evening sky fade away, a few first stars twinkling. Tender, bedtime-warm. No enclosure — they're heading home.
